title: Ambience
keepWhenPausedDesc: Otherwise ambience pauses with the music
followWeatherDesc: Rain rises when it's actually raining outside
followWeatherOff: Needs weather, which is off in Settings

section.subtitle: Cozy layers that play under the music
section.sleepNote: Ambience starts with your music, holds its level through crossfades, and fades out with the sleep timer and wind-down.
section.credit: The café layer is a public-domain recording from Wikimedia Commons. Every other layer is synthesized on your device.
